_comment: A13A1 Oscillator Wideband SMD PCA -- test point expectations.
Two test points are drawn on sheet 5700A-1052 and one of them (TP1) is on
the locator drawing; neither is in the parts list, and no table or
section publishes a value for either. They are recorded as probe targets
with no published value, with what the sheet and §2-136 say about the
node, rather than invented as numbers. The rails are A13's +155 V and
-125 V arriving on P1/P2 and the SCOM return; §5-18 step 8 on A13 is the
published bench check that decides whether this card is at fault.

HV.label: +155 V / -125 V amplifier supplies (from A13 via P1 and P2)

OUT.label: Output driver lines to A13 (+DRIVE, -DRIVE, +BOOT, -BOOT, COLL, EMIT, BASE)

testpoints.condition: Power on, output stage in operate
testpoints.note: Output of U2 (TL071), the amplifier that corrects the input stage's inherent offset, and the node R30 trims: §2-136 says 'potentiometer R30 adjusts the dc zero at the output of U2'. The manuals give no voltage for it. Take it against SCOM (P1 pins 4, 9, 10, 12); a node that will not trim to the dc zero with R30 points at U1/U2 and the CR6 clamp before it points at the input stage.

testpoints.source: Sheet 5700A-1052 (zone B8): the OFFSET line from P1 pin 5
testpoints.note: The OFFSET input as it arrives from A13 on P1 pin 5, drawn on the sheet only -- the locator does not print it. No value is published; it is the dc correction A13 sends this card, so compare it with A13's own offset node rather than expecting a number.

probePoints.label: R30 wiper -- dc zero adjustment
probePoints.note: The 1 k cermet trimmer that sets the dc zero at U2's output. Turn it only with the 22 V range output monitored; no factory setting is published.
